{"id": "E431", "title": "Room examination", "content": "Mira died shortly after 21:10. There is a triangular impression in sealing wax by the door. A bloody sleeve thread lies beneath her hand."}

{"id": "E254", "title": "Mira\u2019s medical examination", "content": "The fatal injury occurred at 21:12, before the clock stopped at 21:30. Dev\u2019s sleeve carried pressure-transfer stains consistent with aid, not proof of an attack."}

{"id": "E504", "title": "Kitchen witness\u2019s signed observation", "content": "From the open service hatch I saw Savitri strike Mira at 21:12. Vedant held the door. I recognized their faces by the lit table. I hid until Dev came in."}

{"id": "E766", "title": "Independent crossing record", "content": "The night porter and cook separately recorded Savitri and Vedant entering the archive corridor at 21:08. The originals predate the public accusation. A seal fragment at the door matches Savitri\u2019s personal seal."}

{"id": "E149", "title": "Recovered planning letter", "content": "Vedant wrote to Savitri: \u201cI know you intend to kill Mira if she refuses. I will keep the corridor clear.\u201d Original paper, seal and retained draft agree."}
{"id": "E174", "title": "Supposed threat from Dev", "content": "\u201cI will silence you before the ninth bell.\u201d Signed Dev. The town constable calls this decisive."}

{"id": "E940", "title": "Threat-letter examination", "content": "The threat uses Savitri\u2019s distinctive corrected letterform and her household stationery. A discarded draft survives in her ash bucket; Dev\u2019s verified writing differs."}

{"id": "E648", "title": "Ash-bucket fragments", "content": "A recoverable draft of the threat is on the reverse of Savitri\u2019s household account. Her instruction to deliver it under Dev\u2019s name is legible."}

{"id": "E690", "title": "Dev\u2019s account and treatment cloth", "content": "Dev arrived at 21:16 and pressed his sleeve to Mira\u2019s wound. The cook witnessed his arrival after the attack. The cloth pattern agrees with the physician\u2019s findings."}

{"id": "E619", "title": "Scene custody ledger", "content": "Anya\u2019s signed inventory lists envelope C before Kabir\u2019s watch and records it missing afterward. A clerk independently saw Kabir pocket it."}
{"id": "E159", "title": "Kabir\u2019s first account", "content": "I touched nothing after the scene was secured. Dev is our man. You know you can trust me."}
{"id": "E163", "title": "Kabir\u2019s arrival register", "content": "The gatekeeper and Anya place Kabir\u2019s first arrival at 21:40, after Mira\u2019s death. The custody breach occurred later."}

{"id": "E679", "title": "Savitri and Vedant\u2019s private exchange", "content": "\u201cThe voice returns when we handle the ward key. It cannot move our hands. We can refuse; yesterday we did. Tonight we will act.\u201d Separate dated diaries record the same bounded experiences."}

{"id": "E138", "title": "Leena and Mira\u2019s correspondence", "content": "Intimate letters describe their affair and agree to meet at the chapel at 20:00. They also discuss protecting the original ninth-ward statement."}

{"id": "E188", "title": "Chapel meeting corroboration", "content": "The chapel keeper\u2019s original entry and separate letters confirm Leena and Mira\u2019s intimate relationship. Leena was with the keeper from 21:00 to 21:25."}

{"id": "E319", "title": "Recovered carrier\u2019s letter", "content": "Kabir, please hide this. I delivered the crates for Savitri and did not ask what was inside. Your brother, Nalin. The envelope was recovered from Kabir\u2019s satchel under witnessed inventory."}
{"id": "E745", "title": "Departure letter", "content": "A resident left to escape a blackmailer over an affair. A road-keeper\u2019s dated receipt places departure before Mira\u2019s murder."}
